compatibility_impact_analysis.torch_load_weights_only: In PyTorch 2.6+, torch.load defaults to weights_only=True. Upstream pretrained_classifier.pth pickles full DenseNet class, requiring weights_only=False for unpickling.
compatibility_impact_analysis.mesh_grid_indexing: Upstream code already specifies indexing='ij', fully compatible with modern torch.meshgrid.
